key_rule: PRNGKey(sequence seed); split 300 times; index 0 unused; subsequent action h uses subkey[h]. Same keys for all candidates and states.
environment_rule: Restore full integration state and mj_step1 phase, goal, elapsed steps, original global and environment RNG. First action from saved parent NPZ. Remaining policy is original frozen Actor. Stop on native termination/truncation or 300.
primary: Seven NEW suffixes; paired wins/losses/ties and success counts per state; B versus A, C versus A, C versus B.
secondary: Parent suffix 0 separately; eight-suffix pooled result includes selected exploratory evidence.

operational_rule.per_target: At least 4 paired success wins and at most 1 paired success loss in seven new suffixes
operational_rule.continue_narrow_hypothesis: At least 2 of 4 predeclared rescued state/candidate pairs meet rule
operational_rule.otherwise: Do not claim stable general defect; stop expansion. Exploratory practical threshold, not statistical significance.

metrics.progress: initial-final and initial-min Euclidean goal distance; descriptive, not route optimality
metrics.stagnation: Each complete 100-step window (101 positions): max displacement from window start <0.5m; fraction; NA for <100 steps
metrics.collision: Wall contact step count and fraction using block_ geom names
other: head height <1m fraction, not a fall diagnosis

stops: First transition error >1e-8 or reward/termination mismatch
limitations: Fixed action per source, no deployable selection rule
300 steps is local, not full-horizon Q
